text:
My YouTube Shorts data after 37 videos:

📈 Shorts tied to real news (same day): 300+ views
📉 Generic "how to" Shorts: 5-20 views

Same channel. Same design. Same voice.
Only difference: timing.

So I changed the plan:
→ No more filler videos
→ Every Short tied to a real date people care about

Lesson for any business on social media:
Post less, but post when your audience is already searching.
